filing_type: Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) official company-profile page — live price snapshot, shareholding disclosure, corporate actions and equity profile
notes:
Retrieved directly from Tadawul's own company-profile page for symbol 1120 (the exchange's own official disclosure, not a third-party aggregator) on 2026-09-11. Tadawul's own page states 'Prices are delayed' -- this is an end-of/during-day delayed snapshot, not a licensed real-time feed; the day's OHLC and volume/turnover are published through the dedicated `market_prices` array (interval '1d', observed_at 2026-09-11) rather than as generic facts -- open/high/low/close, trading volume and turnover are all engine-derived from that table (see src/finengine/domains.py's price_map), so listing them again as manual facts would be redundant and was removed after the first pipeline run correctly rejected it (those metric names are reserved for the market_prices table, not the generic fact extractor -- a real lesson from building this batch, not a guess). The 52-week high/low similarly goes through a second `market_prices` row (interval '1y') rather than a generic fact, for the same reason. market_cap and price_to_earnings are deliberately NOT hand-entered either -- both are already deterministically calculated by the engine from market_prices plus the audited financial-statement facts already published (see aramco-2025-annual-metrics.json for the same is_calculated pattern); manually duplicating them risks a stale or conflicting second value. Only `shares_outstanding` and `share_capital` are published here as plain facts, since the calculation engine needs shares_outstanding to derive market_cap and this page gives an explicitly dated (2026-09-11), authoritative value (Total Issued Shares 6,000,000,000; Paid Capital SAR 60,000,000,000) that also independently reproduces the quoted price: 396,000,000,000 / 6,000,000,000 = 66.00, an internal consistency check that passed.

Ownership: Tadawul's own 'Substantial Shareholders' tab (>=5% holders) returned 'No data available in table' with the footnote 'N/A: the ownership is less than 5%' -- i.e. Tadawul's own official disclosure shows NO shareholder currently holds 5% or more of Al Rajhi Bank. This directly contradicts an unverified third-party claim found earlier this batch (that GOSI holds ~9.6%) -- that third-party figure is NOT carried into this manifest; only Tadawul's own Board-of-Directors ownership table is used, which happens to independently confirm the earlier-found individual figure for the Chairman (~2.18%). This is exactly the scenario the batch's primary-source-only rule exists for.

Corporate actions: 5 historical bonus-share (stock split via capitalisation) events and 5 historical cash dividend distributions, both read directly from Tadawul's own 'Corporate Actions' and 'Dividends' tabs on the same page.

Company-profile cross-check: Tadawul's own 'Company Profile' tab gives a more precise incorporation narrative than the annual report front matter used in the sibling manifest (alrajhi-company-profile-2025.json) -- Royal Decree No. 59 dated 03/11/1407H (1988) for the joint-stock conversion, Ministerial Resolution No. 1398 dated 05/04/1409H for developing it into Al Rajhi Banking and Investment Corporation, and an exact listing date of 1988/12/01 -- these supplement rather than conflict with the annual report's 1957 founding-as-exchange-house account (different milestones in the same history). One real discrepancy found and NOT silently resolved: Tadawul's marketing-style company overview text says '+370,000 POSs', while the audited annual report's Five-Year Summary table (already in the sibling manifest, page 18) gives an exact, dated 991,927 POS terminals for FY2025 -- the annual report's precise dated figure is kept as the published pos_terminals_count fact; Tadawul's rounder overview text is not used for that metric, since it reads as unrevised standing marketing copy rather than a dated disclosure.
